name: panes
description: Windows computers for AI agents. Office, desktop apps, browser tasks and testing.
long_description: Give your agent a persistent Windows computer through MCP. Run commands, transfer files, inspect the screen, use mouse and keyboard, and open a private viewer to watch or take over. Use native Office apps, Windows business software, browser workflows and desktop tests. Connect with your Panes API key, list templates and prices, then start a computer for your task. Compute is prepaid and billed by the second. Office work uses an Office-ready template and your Office sign-in.

api_key.title: Panes API key
api_key.description: Create an API key in your Panes dashboard. Your agent uses this key to control your computers.
